subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Do the shared outbound and QQBot lifecycle owners accept the new registration precedence and immediate reconnect-retry semantics on this exact head?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and well-proven, but it changes a shared external-plugin selection invariant and QQBot queue retry timing that CI cannot fully validate across existing installations.

options.title: Approve exact-head behavior
options.body: Accept the tested operation-aware precedence and account-scoped reconnect replay after the lint failure is resolved.

options.title: Narrow QQBot replay policy
options.body: Keep the resolver repair but tighten or separate the immediate backoff-bypass behavior before merge.

options.title: Split reconnect draining
options.body: Land the resolver changes separately and move QQBot reconnect replay into a dedicated lifecycle review.

recommendation.title: Approve exact-head behavior
recommendation.body: Accept the tested operation-aware precedence and account-scoped reconnect replay after the lint failure is resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work spans both the shared outbound resolver and recovery primitives, providing the strongest evidence-backed ownership signal for this cross-cutting decision.
